text: It is a private Orthodox conversion, and the ITIM organisation is well regarded in many circles. However the conversion will not be accepted by the rabbinate (who hates ITIM), but you will be able to be recognised as Jewish by PIBA and there is the ability to make Aliyah afterwards, but that will take time and can be complex. Whether the conversion will be accepted by other orthodox communities for religious purposes is less clear - it might depend on individual rabbis (it can get very political). We have an article discussing conversion on our website: aic.org.il/conversion-to-judaism-in-israel-a-practical-overview-for-mixed-couples/
